DeterminationBasis: T16-001 directly requires a material claim to name or unambiguously preserve its evaluated scope, evidence basis and applicable status. That explicitly establishes the generic claim-scope identification obligation in CLAIM-003 without requiring a separate test definition.

T16-001 establishes general evaluated-scope identification but does not require temporal scope to be identified when time materially affects claim validity. T16-002 establishes reassessment after material evidence or scope change and prevents silent carry-forward of a historical claim, but it likewise does not require the claim representation itself to identify the applicable temporal scope. CLAIM-004 therefore remains a distinct temporal claim-scope test obligation.
